+int ownerOfRow(const std::size_t n, const std::size_t row, const int ranks) {
+    // This inverse of rowsForRank is exact for the quotient/remainder-free
+    // partition used above, including ranks with no rows when ranks > n.
+    int low = 0;
+    int high = ranks - 1;
+    while (low < high) {
+        const int middle = low + (high - low) / 2;
+        if (rowsForRank(n, middle, ranks).end <= row) {
+            low = middle + 1;
+        } else {
+            high = middle;
+        }
+    }

+        return cudaMemcpy2D(panel.data(), block_size * sizeof(double),
+                            matrix_ + (row - range_.begin) * n_ + column,
+                            n_ * sizeof(double),
+                            block_size * sizeof(double), rows,
+                            cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }

+    bool uploadPanel(const std::vector<double>& panel,
+                     const std::size_t rows,
+                     const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy(panel_, panel.data(),
+                          rows * block_size * sizeof(double),
+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) == cudaSuccess;
+    }

+    bool updateTrailing(const std::size_t k,
+                        const std::size_t first,
+                        const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0 || first >= n_) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int x_threads = 32;
+        constexpr unsigned int y_threads = 8;
+        const dim3 threads(x_threads, y_threads, 1);
+        const dim3 blocks(
+            static_cast<unsigned int>((n_ - first + x_threads - 1) /
+                                       x_threads),
+            static_cast<unsigned int>((range_.size() + y_threads - 1) /
+                                       y_threads),
+            1);
+        updateTrailingKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(
+            matrix_, panel_, n_, range_.size(), range_.begin, k, first,
+            block_size);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool zeroUpper() const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int threads = 256;
+        const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(
+            (range_.size() + threads - 1) / threads);
+        zeroUpperKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(matrix_, n_, range_.size(),
+                                             range_.begin);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool download(std::vector<double>& host_matrix) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy(host_matrix.data(), matrix_,
+                          host_matrix.size() * sizeof(double),
+                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;

+// Each thread updates one element of the local lower-triangular trailing
+// matrix.  The panel is replicated on every rank, so this kernel performs all
+// of the O(n^3) work without MPI communication inside a CUDA launch.
+__global__ void updateTrailingKernel(double* matrix,
+                                     const double* panel,
+                                     const std::size_t n,
+                                     const std::size_t local_rows,
+                                     const std::size_t row_begin,
+                                     const std::size_t k,
+                                     const std::size_t first,
+                                     const std::size_t block_size) {
+    const std::size_t j = first +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t local_i =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+
+    if (local_i >= local_rows || j >= n) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t i = row_begin + local_i;
+    if (i < first || j > i) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double* const matrix_row = matrix + local_i * n;
+    const double* const panel_row = panel + (j - first) * block_size;
+    double sum = 0.0;
+    for (std::size_t t = 0; t < block_size; ++t) {
+        sum += matrix_row[k + t] * panel_row[t];
+    }
+    matrix[local_i * n + j] -= sum;
+}

+RowRange rowsForRank(const std::size_t n, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t p = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t count = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    return {n * p / count, n * (p + 1) / count};

+int ownerOfRow(const std::size_t n, const std::size_t row, const int ranks) {
+    // This inverse of rowsForRank is exact for the quotient/remainder-free
+    // partition used above, including ranks with no rows when ranks > n.
+    int low = 0;
+    int high = ranks - 1;
+    while (low < high) {
+        const int middle = low + (high - low) / 2;
+        if (rowsForRank(n, middle, ranks).end <= row) {
+            low = middle + 1;
+        } else {
+            high = middle;
+        }
+    }
+    return low;
+}

+                       matrix_elements * sizeof(double),
+                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) != cudaSuccess) {
+            release();
+            return false;
+        }
+        enabled_ = true;
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    void release() {
+        if (matrix_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(matrix_);
+        }
+        if (panel_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(panel_);
+        }
+        if (diagonal_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(diagonal_);
+        }
+        matrix_ = nullptr;
+        panel_ = nullptr;
+        diagonal_ = nullptr;
+        enabled_ = false;
+    }
+
+    bool downloadTile(std::vector<double>& tile,
+                      const std::size_t row,
+                      const std::size_t column,
+                      const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy2D(tile.data(), block_size * sizeof(double),
+                            matrix_ + (row - range_.begin) * n_ + column,
+                            n_ * sizeof(double),
+                            block_size * sizeof(double), block_size,
+                            cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool uploadTile(const std::vector<double>& tile,
+                    const std::size_t row,
+                    const std::size_t column,
+                    const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy2D(matrix_ + (row - range_.begin) * n_ + column,
+                            n_ * sizeof(double), tile.data(),
+                            block_size * sizeof(double),
+                            block_size * sizeof(double), block_size,
+                            cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool uploadDiagonal(const std::vector<double>& tile,
+                        const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy(diagonal_, tile.data(),
+                          block_size * block_size * sizeof(double),
+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool solvePanel(const std::size_t k,
+                    const std::size_t first,
+                    const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int threads = 256;
+        const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(
+            (range_.size() + threads - 1) / threads);
+        solvePanelKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(matrix_, diagonal_, n_,
+                                               range_.size(), range_.begin,
+                                               k, first, block_size);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool downloadPanel(std::vector<double>& panel,
+                       const std::size_t row,
+                       const std::size_t rows,
+                       const std::size_t column,
+                       const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (rows == 0) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        return cudaMemcpy2D(panel.data(), block_size * sizeof(double),
+                            matrix_ + (row - range_.begin) * n_ + column,
+                            n_ * sizeof(double),
+                            block_size * sizeof(double), rows,
+                            cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool uploadPanel(const std::vector<double>& panel,
+                     const std::size_t rows,
+                     const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy(panel_, panel.data(),
+                          rows * block_size * sizeof(double),
+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool updateTrailing(const std::size_t k,
+                        const std::size_t first,
+                        const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0 || first >= n_) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int x_threads = 32;
+        constexpr unsigned int y_threads = 8;
+        const dim3 threads(x_threads, y_threads, 1);
+        const dim3 blocks(
+            static_cast<unsigned int>((n_ - first + x_threads - 1) /
+                                       x_threads),
+            static_cast<unsigned int>((range_.size() + y_threads - 1) /
+                                       y_threads),
+            1);
+        updateTrailingKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(
+            matrix_, panel_, n_, range_.size(), range_.begin, k, first,
+            block_size);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool zeroUpper() const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int threads = 256;
+        const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(
+            (range_.size() + threads - 1) / threads);
+        zeroUpperKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(matrix_, n_, range_.size(),
+                                             range_.begin);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool download(std::vector<double>& host_matrix) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy(host_matrix.data(), matrix_,
+                          host_matrix.size() * sizeof(double),
+                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+private:
+    bool enabled_ = false;
+    std::size_t n_ = 0;
+    std::size_t max_block_ = 0;
+    RowRange range_{0, 0};
+    double* matrix_ = nullptr;
+    double* panel_ = nullptr;
+    double* diagonal_ = nullptr;
+};

+    std::printf("  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\n");

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
 }

+        std::printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", milliseconds);
+        const double operations = static_cast<double>(n) * n * n / 3.0;
+        const double gflops = operations / elapsed_max / 1.0e9;
+        std::printf("Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\n", gflops);
+
+        if (print_results_flag) {
+            print_results(result, "CholeskyL");
+        }
+
+        if (validate) {
+            std::printf("Validating result...\n");
+            const bool valid = validateCholesky(result, original, n);
+            std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
+            success = valid;
+        }
+    }
+
+    int root_success = success ? 1 : 0;
+    MPI_Bcast(&root_success, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+    cuda_matrix.release();
+    MPI_Comm_free(&local_communicator);
+    MPI_Finalize();
+    return root_success ? 0 : 1;

+                    const std::size_t column,
+                    const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy2D(matrix_ + (row - range_.begin) * n_ + column,
+                            n_ * sizeof(double), tile.data(),
+                            block_size * sizeof(double),
+                            block_size * sizeof(double), block_size,
+                            cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool uploadDiagonal(const std::vector<double>& tile,
+                        const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy(diagonal_, tile.data(),
+                          block_size * block_size * sizeof(double),
+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool solvePanel(const std::size_t k,
+                    const std::size_t first,
+                    const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int threads = 256;
+        const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(
+            (range_.size() + threads - 1) / threads);
+        solvePanelKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(matrix_, diagonal_, n_,
+                                               range_.size(), range_.begin,
+                                               k, first, block_size);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool downloadPanel(std::vector<double>& panel,
+                       const std::size_t row,
+                       const std::size_t rows,
+                       const std::size_t column,
+                       const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (rows == 0) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        return cudaMemcpy2D(panel.data(), block_size * sizeof(double),
+                            matrix_ + (row - range_.begin) * n_ + column,
+                            n_ * sizeof(double),
+                            block_size * sizeof(double), rows,
+                            cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool uploadPanel(const std::vector<double>& panel,
+                     const std::size_t rows,
+                     const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy(panel_, panel.data(),
+                          rows * block_size * sizeof(double),
+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool updateTrailing(const std::size_t k,
+                        const std::size_t first,
+                        const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0 || first >= n_) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int x_threads = 32;
+        constexpr unsigned int y_threads = 8;
+        const dim3 threads(x_threads, y_threads, 1);
+        const dim3 blocks(
+            static_cast<unsigned int>((n_ - first + x_threads - 1) /
+                                       x_threads),
+            static_cast<unsigned int>((range_.size() + y_threads - 1) /
+                                       y_threads),
+            1);
+        updateTrailingKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(
+            matrix_, panel_, n_, range_.size(), range_.begin, k, first,
+            block_size);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool zeroUpper() const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int threads = 256;
+        const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(
+            (range_.size() + threads - 1) / threads);
+        zeroUpperKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(matrix_, n_, range_.size(),
+                                             range_.begin);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool download(std::vector<double>& host_matrix) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy(host_matrix.data(), matrix_,
+                          host_matrix.size() * sizeof(double),
+                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+private:
+    bool enabled_ = false;
+    std::size_t n_ = 0;
+    std::size_t max_block_ = 0;
+    RowRange range_{0, 0};
+    double* matrix_ = nullptr;
+    double* panel_ = nullptr;
+    double* diagonal_ = nullptr;
+};

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;

+// Each thread updates one element of the local lower-triangular trailing
+// matrix.  The panel is replicated on every rank, so this kernel performs all
+// of the O(n^3) work without MPI communication inside a CUDA launch.
+__global__ void updateTrailingKernel(double* matrix,
+                                     const double* panel,
+                                     const std::size_t n,
+                                     const std::size_t local_rows,
+                                     const std::size_t row_begin,
+                                     const std::size_t k,
+                                     const std::size_t first,
+                                     const std::size_t block_size) {
+    const std::size_t j = first +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t local_i =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+
+    if (local_i >= local_rows || j >= n) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t i = row_begin + local_i;
+    if (i < first || j > i) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double* const matrix_row = matrix + local_i * n;
+    const double* const panel_row = panel + (j - first) * block_size;
+    double sum = 0.0;
+    for (std::size_t t = 0; t < block_size; ++t) {
+        sum += matrix_row[k + t] * panel_row[t];
+    }
+    matrix[local_i * n + j] -= sum;

+    // partition used above, including ranks with no rows when ranks > n.
+    int low = 0;

+                            cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool uploadPanel(const std::vector<double>& panel,
+                     const std::size_t rows,
+                     const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy(panel_, panel.data(),
+                          rows * block_size * sizeof(double),
+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool updateTrailing(const std::size_t k,
+                        const std::size_t first,
+                        const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0 || first >= n_) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int x_threads = 32;
+        constexpr unsigned int y_threads = 8;
+        const dim3 threads(x_threads, y_threads, 1);
+        const dim3 blocks(
+            static_cast<unsigned int>((n_ - first + x_threads - 1) /
+                                       x_threads),
+            static_cast<unsigned int>((range_.size() + y_threads - 1) /
+                                       y_threads),
+            1);
+        updateTrailingKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(
+            matrix_, panel_, n_, range_.size(), range_.begin, k, first,
+            block_size);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool zeroUpper() const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int threads = 256;
+        const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(
+            (range_.size() + threads - 1) / threads);
+        zeroUpperKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(matrix_, n_, range_.size(),
+                                             range_.begin);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool download(std::vector<double>& host_matrix) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy(host_matrix.data(), matrix_,
+                          host_matrix.size() * sizeof(double),
+                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;

+// Each thread updates one element of the local lower-triangular trailing
+// matrix.  The panel is replicated on every rank, so this kernel performs all
+// of the O(n^3) work without MPI communication inside a CUDA launch.
+__global__ void updateTrailingKernel(double* matrix,
+                                     const double* panel,
+                                     const std::size_t n,
+                                     const std::size_t local_rows,
+                                     const std::size_t row_begin,
+                                     const std::size_t k,
+                                     const std::size_t first,
+                                     const std::size_t block_size) {
+    const std::size_t j = first +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t local_i =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+
+    if (local_i >= local_rows || j >= n) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t i = row_begin + local_i;
+    if (i < first || j > i) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double* const matrix_row = matrix + local_i * n;
+    const double* const panel_row = panel + (j - first) * block_size;
+    double sum = 0.0;
+    for (std::size_t t = 0; t < block_size; ++t) {
+        sum += matrix_row[k + t] * panel_row[t];
+    }
+    matrix[local_i * n + j] -= sum;
+}

+std::size_t checkedProduct(const std::size_t a, const std::size_t b) {
+    if (a != 0 && b > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() / a) {

+RowRange rowsForRank(const std::size_t n, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t p = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t count = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    return {n * p / count, n * (p + 1) / count};
+}
+
+int ownerOfRow(const std::size_t n, const std::size_t row, const int ranks) {
+    // This inverse of rowsForRank is exact for the quotient/remainder-free
+    // partition used above, including ranks with no rows when ranks > n.
+    int low = 0;
+    int high = ranks - 1;
+    while (low < high) {
+        const int middle = low + (high - low) / 2;
+        if (rowsForRank(n, middle, ranks).end <= row) {
+            low = middle + 1;
+        } else {
+            high = middle;
+        }
+    }
+    return low;
+}

+class CudaLocalMatrix {
+public:
+    CudaLocalMatrix() = default;
+    CudaLocalMatrix(const CudaLocalMatrix&) = delete;
+    CudaLocalMatrix& operator=(const CudaLocalMatrix&) = delete;
+
+    ~CudaLocalMatrix() { release(); }

+    bool initialize(const std::vector<double>& host_matrix,
+                    const RowRange range,
+                    const std::size_t n,
+                    const std::size_t max_block,
+                    const int local_rank) {
+        n_ = n;
+        range_ = range;
+        max_block_ = max_block;
+
+        int device_count = 0;
+        cudaError_t error = cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count);
+        if (error != cudaSuccess || device_count == 0 || range.size() == 0) {
+            cudaGetLastError();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        error = cudaSetDevice(local_rank % device_count);
+        if (error != cudaSuccess) {
+            cudaGetLastError();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const std::size_t matrix_elements = checkedProduct(range.size(), n);
+        const std::size_t panel_elements = checkedProduct(n, max_block);
+        if (matrix_elements == 0 || panel_elements == 0) {
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        if (cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&matrix_),
+                       matrix_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||
+            cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&panel_),
+                       panel_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||
+            cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&diagonal_),
+                       max_block * max_block * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess) {
+            release();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        if (cudaMemcpy(matrix_, host_matrix.data(),
+                       matrix_elements * sizeof(double),
+                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) != cudaSuccess) {
+            release();
+            return false;
+        }
+        enabled_ = true;
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    void release() {
+        if (matrix_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(matrix_);
+        }
+        if (panel_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(panel_);
+        }
+        if (diagonal_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(diagonal_);
+        }
+        matrix_ = nullptr;
+        panel_ = nullptr;
+        diagonal_ = nullptr;
+        enabled_ = false;
+    }
+
+    bool downloadTile(std::vector<double>& tile,

+                      const std::size_t block_size) const {

+                            matrix_ + (row - range_.begin) * n_ + column,

+    bool solvePanel(const std::size_t k,
+                    const std::size_t first,
+                    const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int threads = 256;
+        const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(
+            (range_.size() + threads - 1) / threads);
+        solvePanelKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(matrix_, diagonal_, n_,
+                                               range_.size(), range_.begin,
+                                               k, first, block_size);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool downloadPanel(std::vector<double>& panel,

+        }

+                            cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool uploadPanel(const std::vector<double>& panel,

+    bool updateTrailing(const std::size_t k,
+                        const std::size_t first,
+                        const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0 || first >= n_) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int x_threads = 32;
+        constexpr unsigned int y_threads = 8;
+        const dim3 threads(x_threads, y_threads, 1);
+        const dim3 blocks(
+            static_cast<unsigned int>((n_ - first + x_threads - 1) /
+                                       x_threads),
+            static_cast<unsigned int>((range_.size() + y_threads - 1) /
+                                       y_threads),
+            1);
+        updateTrailingKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(
+            matrix_, panel_, n_, range_.size(), range_.begin, k, first,
+            block_size);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }

+    bool zeroUpper() const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int threads = 256;
+        const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(
+            (range_.size() + threads - 1) / threads);
+        zeroUpperKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(matrix_, n_, range_.size(),
+                                             range_.begin);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool download(std::vector<double>& host_matrix) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy(host_matrix.data(), matrix_,
+                          host_matrix.size() * sizeof(double),
+                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }

The runtime checks pass for one and four MPI ranks, including uneven row partitions and more ranks than matrix rows; the CUDA path validated with errors below the original tolerance, and a host-only MPI/OpenMP compile also passed. I found one build portability issue in the default CMake architecture selection (CMake was initializing its legacy default before my override), so I’m correcting that before the final rebuild.

+// Each thread updates one element of the local lower-triangular trailing
+// matrix.  The panel is replicated on every rank, so this kernel performs all
+// of the O(n^3) work without MPI communication inside a CUDA launch.
+__global__ void updateTrailingKernel(double* matrix,
+                                     const double* panel,
+                                     const std::size_t n,
+                                     const std::size_t local_rows,
+                                     const std::size_t row_begin,
+                                     const std::size_t k,
+                                     const std::size_t first,
+                                     const std::size_t block_size) {
+    const std::size_t j = first +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t local_i =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+
+    if (local_i >= local_rows || j >= n) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t i = row_begin + local_i;
+    if (i < first || j > i) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double* const matrix_row = matrix + local_i * n;
+    const double* const panel_row = panel + (j - first) * block_size;
+    double sum = 0.0;
+    for (std::size_t t = 0; t < block_size; ++t) {
+        sum += matrix_row[k + t] * panel_row[t];
+    }
+    matrix[local_i * n + j] -= sum;

+RowRange rowsForRank(const std::size_t n, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t p = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t count = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    return {n * p / count, n * (p + 1) / count};

+int ownerOfRow(const std::size_t n, const std::size_t row, const int ranks) {
+    // This inverse of rowsForRank is exact for the quotient/remainder-free
+    // partition used above, including ranks with no rows when ranks > n.
+    int low = 0;
+    int high = ranks - 1;
+    while (low < high) {
+        const int middle = low + (high - low) / 2;
+        if (rowsForRank(n, middle, ranks).end <= row) {
+            low = middle + 1;
+        } else {
+            high = middle;
+        }
+    }
+    return low;

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;

+__global__ void updateTrailingKernel(double* matrix,
+                                     const double* panel,
+                                     const std::size_t n,
+                                     const std::size_t local_rows,
+                                     const std::size_t row_begin,
+                                     const std::size_t k,
+                                     const std::size_t first,
+                                     const std::size_t block_size) {
+    const std::size_t j = first +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t local_i =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+
+    if (local_i >= local_rows || j >= n) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t i = row_begin + local_i;
+    if (i < first || j > i) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double* const matrix_row = matrix + local_i * n;
+    const double* const panel_row = panel + (j - first) * block_size;
+    double sum = 0.0;
+    for (std::size_t t = 0; t < block_size; ++t) {
+        sum += matrix_row[k + t] * panel_row[t];
+    }
+    matrix[local_i * n + j] -= sum;
+}

+std::size_t checkedProduct(const std::size_t a, const std::size_t b) {
+    if (a != 0 && b > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() / a) {

+struct RowRange {
+    std::size_t begin;
+    std::size_t end;

+RowRange rowsForRank(const std::size_t n, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t p = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t count = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    return {n * p / count, n * (p + 1) / count};
+}
+
+int ownerOfRow(const std::size_t n, const std::size_t row, const int ranks) {
+    // This inverse of rowsForRank is exact for the quotient/remainder-free
+    // partition used above, including ranks with no rows when ranks > n.
+    int low = 0;
+    int high = ranks - 1;
+    while (low < high) {
+        const int middle = low + (high - low) / 2;
+        if (rowsForRank(n, middle, ranks).end <= row) {
+            low = middle + 1;
+        } else {
+            high = middle;
+        }
+    }
+    return low;
+}

+    bool initialize(const std::vector<double>& host_matrix,

+
+        int device_count = 0;
+        cudaError_t error = cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count);
+        if (error != cudaSuccess || device_count == 0 || range.size() == 0) {

+        }
+
+        error = cudaSetDevice(local_rank % device_count);
+        if (error != cudaSuccess) {
+            cudaGetLastError();
+            return false;
+        }
+

+        const std::size_t panel_elements = checkedProduct(n, max_block);
+        if (matrix_elements == 0 || panel_elements == 0) {
+            return false;
+        }
+

+                       matrix_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||

+                       panel_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||

+            return false;

+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;

+// Each thread updates one element of the local lower-triangular trailing
+// matrix.  The panel is replicated on every rank, so this kernel performs all
+// of the O(n^3) work without MPI communication inside a CUDA launch.
+__global__ void updateTrailingKernel(double* matrix,
+                                     const double* panel,
+                                     const std::size_t n,
+                                     const std::size_t local_rows,
+                                     const std::size_t row_begin,
+                                     const std::size_t k,
+                                     const std::size_t first,
+                                     const std::size_t block_size) {
+    const std::size_t j = first +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t local_i =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+
+    if (local_i >= local_rows || j >= n) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t i = row_begin + local_i;
+    if (i < first || j > i) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double* const matrix_row = matrix + local_i * n;
+    const double* const panel_row = panel + (j - first) * block_size;
+    double sum = 0.0;
+    for (std::size_t t = 0; t < block_size; ++t) {

+RowRange rowsForRank(const std::size_t n, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t p = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t count = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    return {n * p / count, n * (p + 1) / count};
+}
+
+int ownerOfRow(const std::size_t n, const std::size_t row, const int ranks) {
+    // This inverse of rowsForRank is exact for the quotient/remainder-free
+    // partition used above, including ranks with no rows when ranks > n.
+    int low = 0;
+    int high = ranks - 1;
+    while (low < high) {
+        const int middle = low + (high - low) / 2;
+        if (rowsForRank(n, middle, ranks).end <= row) {
+            low = middle + 1;
+        } else {
+            high = middle;
+        }
+    }
+    return low;
+}

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
 }

+// Each thread updates one element of the local lower-triangular trailing
+// matrix.  The panel is replicated on every rank, so this kernel performs all
+// of the O(n^3) work without MPI communication inside a CUDA launch.
+__global__ void updateTrailingKernel(double* matrix,
+                                     const double* panel,
+                                     const std::size_t n,
+                                     const std::size_t local_rows,
+                                     const std::size_t row_begin,
+                                     const std::size_t k,
+                                     const std::size_t first,
+                                     const std::size_t block_size) {
+    const std::size_t j = first +
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t local_i =
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+
+    if (local_i >= local_rows || j >= n) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t i = row_begin + local_i;
+    if (i < first || j > i) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double* const matrix_row = matrix + local_i * n;
+    const double* const panel_row = panel + (j - first) * block_size;
+    double sum = 0.0;
+    for (std::size_t t = 0; t < block_size; ++t) {
+        sum += matrix_row[k + t] * panel_row[t];
+    }
+    matrix[local_i * n + j] -= sum;

+        return;
+    }

+std::size_t checkedProduct(const std::size_t a, const std::size_t b) {
+    if (a != 0 && b > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() / a) {
+        return 0;
+    }
+    return a * b;
+}
+
+bool fitsMpiInt(const std::size_t value) {
+    return value <= static_cast<std::size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max());
+}
+
+struct RowRange {
+    std::size_t begin;
+    std::size_t end;
+
+    std::size_t size() const { return end - begin; }
+};
+
+RowRange rowsForRank(const std::size_t n, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t p = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t count = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    return {n * p / count, n * (p + 1) / count};
+}
+
+int ownerOfRow(const std::size_t n, const std::size_t row, const int ranks) {
+    // This inverse of rowsForRank is exact for the quotient/remainder-free
+    // partition used above, including ranks with no rows when ranks > n.
+    int low = 0;
+    int high = ranks - 1;
+    while (low < high) {
+        const int middle = low + (high - low) / 2;
+        if (rowsForRank(n, middle, ranks).end <= row) {
+            low = middle + 1;
+        } else {
+            high = middle;
+        }
+    }
+    return low;
+}

+
+        int device_count = 0;

+

+        const std::size_t panel_elements = checkedProduct(n, max_block);
+        if (matrix_elements == 0 || panel_elements == 0) {

+        }
+

+                       matrix_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||

+                       panel_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
 }

+__global__ void updateTrailingKernel(double* matrix,

+                                     const std::size_t n,

+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;

+RowRange rowsForRank(const std::size_t n, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t p = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t count = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    return {n * p / count, n * (p + 1) / count};
+}
+
+int ownerOfRow(const std::size_t n, const std::size_t row, const int ranks) {
+    // This inverse of rowsForRank is exact for the quotient/remainder-free
+    // partition used above, including ranks with no rows when ranks > n.
+    int low = 0;
+    int high = ranks - 1;
+    while (low < high) {
+        const int middle = low + (high - low) / 2;
+        if (rowsForRank(n, middle, ranks).end <= row) {
+            low = middle + 1;
+        } else {
+            high = middle;
+        }
+    }
+    return low;
+}

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
 }

+__global__ void updateTrailingKernel(double* matrix,

+                                     const std::size_t n,

+int ownerOfRow(const std::size_t n, const std::size_t row, const int ranks) {
+    // This inverse of rowsForRank is exact for the quotient/remainder-free
+    // partition used above, including ranks with no rows when ranks > n.

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;

+__global__ void updateTrailingKernel(double* matrix,

+                                     const std::size_t n,

+                       panel_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
 }

+__global__ void updateTrailingKernel(double* matrix,

+                                     const std::size_t n,
+                                     const std::size_t local_rows,

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
 }

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
 }

+                       panel_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
 }

+int ownerOfRow(const std::size_t n, const std::size_t row, const int ranks) {
+    // This inverse of rowsForRank is exact for the quotient/remainder-free
+    // partition used above, including ranks with no rows when ranks > n.

+class CudaLocalMatrix {
+public:
+    CudaLocalMatrix() = default;

+    CudaLocalMatrix& operator=(const CudaLocalMatrix&) = delete;
+
+    ~CudaLocalMatrix() { release(); }

+    bool initialize(const std::vector<double>& host_matrix,
+                    const RowRange range,
+                    const std::size_t n,
+                    const std::size_t max_block,
+                    const int local_rank) {
+        n_ = n;
+        range_ = range;
+        max_block_ = max_block;
+
+        int device_count = 0;
+        cudaError_t error = cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count);
+        if (error != cudaSuccess || device_count == 0 || range.size() == 0) {
+            cudaGetLastError();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        error = cudaSetDevice(local_rank % device_count);
+        if (error != cudaSuccess) {
+            cudaGetLastError();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const std::size_t matrix_elements = checkedProduct(range.size(), n);
+        const std::size_t panel_elements = checkedProduct(n, max_block);
+        if (matrix_elements == 0 || panel_elements == 0) {
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        if (cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&matrix_),
+                       matrix_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||
+            cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&panel_),
+                       panel_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||
+            cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&diagonal_),
+                       max_block * max_block * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess) {
+            release();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        if (cudaMemcpy(matrix_, host_matrix.data(),
+                       matrix_elements * sizeof(double),
+                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) != cudaSuccess) {
+            release();
+            return false;
+        }
+        enabled_ = true;
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    void release() {
+        if (matrix_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(matrix_);
+        }
+        if (panel_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(panel_);
+        }
+        if (diagonal_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(diagonal_);
+        }
+        matrix_ = nullptr;
+        panel_ = nullptr;
+        diagonal_ = nullptr;
+        enabled_ = false;
+    }

+                            matrix_ + (row - range_.begin) * n_ + column,

+    bool solvePanel(const std::size_t k,

+    }
+
+    bool downloadPanel(std::vector<double>& panel,

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
 }

+                       panel_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;

+class CudaLocalMatrix {

+    ~CudaLocalMatrix() { release(); }

+    bool initialize(const std::vector<double>& host_matrix,
+                    const RowRange range,
+                    const std::size_t n,
+                    const std::size_t max_block,
+                    const int local_rank) {
+        n_ = n;
+        range_ = range;
+        max_block_ = max_block;
+
+        int device_count = 0;
+        cudaError_t error = cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count);
+        if (error != cudaSuccess || device_count == 0 || range.size() == 0) {
+            cudaGetLastError();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        error = cudaSetDevice(local_rank % device_count);
+        if (error != cudaSuccess) {
+            cudaGetLastError();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const std::size_t matrix_elements = checkedProduct(range.size(), n);
+        const std::size_t panel_elements = checkedProduct(n, max_block);
+        if (matrix_elements == 0 || panel_elements == 0) {
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        if (cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&matrix_),
+                       matrix_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||
+            cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&panel_),
+                       panel_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||
+            cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&diagonal_),
+                       max_block * max_block * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess) {
+            release();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        if (cudaMemcpy(matrix_, host_matrix.data(),
+                       matrix_elements * sizeof(double),
+                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) != cudaSuccess) {
+            release();
+            return false;
+        }
+        enabled_ = true;
+        return true;
+    }

+    void release() {
+        if (matrix_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(matrix_);
+        }
+        if (panel_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(panel_);
+        }
+        if (diagonal_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(diagonal_);
+        }
+        matrix_ = nullptr;
+        panel_ = nullptr;
+        diagonal_ = nullptr;
+        enabled_ = false;
+    }

+                            matrix_ + (row - range_.begin) * n_ + column,
+                            n_ * sizeof(double),

+    }

+        return cudaMemcpy2D(matrix_ + (row - range_.begin) * n_ + column,

+        return cudaMemcpy(diagonal_, tile.data(),

+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) == cudaSuccess;
+    }

+    bool solvePanel(const std::size_t k,
+                    const std::size_t first,
+                    const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0) {
+            return true;

+            (range_.size() + threads - 1) / threads);

+    }
+
+    bool downloadPanel(std::vector<double>& panel,
+                       const std::size_t row,

+                       const std::size_t column,

+    }

+    bool uploadPanel(const std::vector<double>& panel,

+    }

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
 }

+RowRange rowsForRank(const std::size_t n, const int rank, const int ranks) {

+int ownerOfRow(const std::size_t n, const std::size_t row, const int ranks) {
+    // This inverse of rowsForRank is exact for the quotient/remainder-free
+    // partition used above, including ranks with no rows when ranks > n.
+    int low = 0;
+    int high = ranks - 1;
+    while (low < high) {

+        if (rowsForRank(n, middle, ranks).end <= row) {
+            low = middle + 1;

+class CudaLocalMatrix {

+    bool initialize(const std::vector<double>& host_matrix,
+                    const RowRange range,
+                    const std::size_t n,
+                    const std::size_t max_block,
+                    const int local_rank) {
+        n_ = n;
+        range_ = range;
+        max_block_ = max_block;
+
+        int device_count = 0;
+        cudaError_t error = cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count);
+        if (error != cudaSuccess || device_count == 0 || range.size() == 0) {
+            cudaGetLastError();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        error = cudaSetDevice(local_rank % device_count);
+        if (error != cudaSuccess) {
+            cudaGetLastError();
+            return false;
+        }

+        const std::size_t matrix_elements = checkedProduct(range.size(), n);
+        const std::size_t panel_elements = checkedProduct(n, max_block);
+        if (matrix_elements == 0 || panel_elements == 0) {
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        if (cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&matrix_),
+                       matrix_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||
+            cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&panel_),
+                       panel_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||
+            cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&diagonal_),
+                       max_block * max_block * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess) {
+            release();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        if (cudaMemcpy(matrix_, host_matrix.data(),
+                       matrix_elements * sizeof(double),
+                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) != cudaSuccess) {
+            release();
+            return false;
+        }
+        enabled_ = true;
+        return true;
+    }

+    void release() {
+        if (matrix_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(matrix_);
+        }
+        if (panel_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(panel_);
+        }
+        if (diagonal_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(diagonal_);
+        }
+        matrix_ = nullptr;
+        panel_ = nullptr;
+        diagonal_ = nullptr;
+        enabled_ = false;
+    }

+                            cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) == cudaSuccess;

+        return cudaMemcpy(diagonal_, tile.data(),

+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) == cudaSuccess;
+    }

+    bool solvePanel(const std::size_t k,
+                    const std::size_t first,
+                    const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0) {
+            return true;
+        }

+        const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(
+            (range_.size() + threads - 1) / threads);

+                                               range_.size(), range_.begin,
+                                               k, first, block_size);

+    }
+
+    bool downloadPanel(std::vector<double>& panel,
+                       const std::size_t row,

+                            cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }

+    bool uploadPanel(const std::vector<double>& panel,

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
 }

+__global__ void updateTrailingKernel(double* matrix,

+        static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;

+RowRange rowsForRank(const std::size_t n, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t p = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t count = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    return {n * p / count, n * (p + 1) / count};

+int ownerOfRow(const std::size_t n, const std::size_t row, const int ranks) {
+    // This inverse of rowsForRank is exact for the quotient/remainder-free
+    // partition used above, including ranks with no rows when ranks > n.
+    int low = 0;
+    int high = ranks - 1;
+    while (low < high) {
+        const int middle = low + (high - low) / 2;
+        if (rowsForRank(n, middle, ranks).end <= row) {
+            low = middle + 1;
+        } else {
+            high = middle;
+        }
+    }
+    return low;

+    CudaLocalMatrix& operator=(const CudaLocalMatrix&) = delete;
+
+    ~CudaLocalMatrix() { release(); }
+
+    bool initialize(const std::vector<double>& host_matrix,
+                    const RowRange range,
+                    const std::size_t n,
+                    const std::size_t max_block,
+                    const int local_rank) {
+        n_ = n;
+        range_ = range;
+        max_block_ = max_block;
+
+        int device_count = 0;
+        cudaError_t error = cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count);
+        if (error != cudaSuccess || device_count == 0 || range.size() == 0) {
+            cudaGetLastError();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        error = cudaSetDevice(local_rank % device_count);
+        if (error != cudaSuccess) {
+            cudaGetLastError();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        const std::size_t matrix_elements = checkedProduct(range.size(), n);
+        const std::size_t panel_elements = checkedProduct(n, max_block);
+        if (matrix_elements == 0 || panel_elements == 0) {
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        if (cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&matrix_),
+                       matrix_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||
+            cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&panel_),
+                       panel_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||
+            cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&diagonal_),
+                       max_block * max_block * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess) {
+            release();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        if (cudaMemcpy(matrix_, host_matrix.data(),
+                       matrix_elements * sizeof(double),
+                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) != cudaSuccess) {
+            release();
+            return false;
+        }
+        enabled_ = true;
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    void release() {
+        if (matrix_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(matrix_);
+        }
+        if (panel_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(panel_);
+        }
+        if (diagonal_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(diagonal_);
+        }
+        matrix_ = nullptr;
+        panel_ = nullptr;
+        diagonal_ = nullptr;
+        enabled_ = false;
+    }
+
+    bool downloadTile(std::vector<double>& tile,
+                      const std::size_t row,
+                      const std::size_t column,
+                      const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy2D(tile.data(), block_size * sizeof(double),
+                            matrix_ + (row - range_.begin) * n_ + column,
+                            n_ * sizeof(double),
+                            block_size * sizeof(double), block_size,
+                            cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool uploadTile(const std::vector<double>& tile,
+                    const std::size_t row,
+                    const std::size_t column,
+                    const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy2D(matrix_ + (row - range_.begin) * n_ + column,
+                            n_ * sizeof(double), tile.data(),
+                            block_size * sizeof(double),
+                            block_size * sizeof(double), block_size,
+                            cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool uploadDiagonal(const std::vector<double>& tile,
+                        const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy(diagonal_, tile.data(),
+                          block_size * block_size * sizeof(double),
+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool solvePanel(const std::size_t k,
+                    const std::size_t first,
+                    const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int threads = 256;
+        const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(
+            (range_.size() + threads - 1) / threads);
+        solvePanelKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(matrix_, diagonal_, n_,
+                                               range_.size(), range_.begin,
+                                               k, first, block_size);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool downloadPanel(std::vector<double>& panel,
+                       const std::size_t row,
+                       const std::size_t rows,
+                       const std::size_t column,
+                       const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (rows == 0) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        return cudaMemcpy2D(panel.data(), block_size * sizeof(double),
+                            matrix_ + (row - range_.begin) * n_ + column,
+                            n_ * sizeof(double),
+                            block_size * sizeof(double), rows,
+                            cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool uploadPanel(const std::vector<double>& panel,
+                     const std::size_t rows,
+                     const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy(panel_, panel.data(),
+                          rows * block_size * sizeof(double),
+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool updateTrailing(const std::size_t k,
+                        const std::size_t first,
+                        const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0 || first >= n_) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int x_threads = 32;
+        constexpr unsigned int y_threads = 8;
+        const dim3 threads(x_threads, y_threads, 1);
+        const dim3 blocks(
+            static_cast<unsigned int>((n_ - first + x_threads - 1) /
+                                       x_threads),
+            static_cast<unsigned int>((range_.size() + y_threads - 1) /
+                                       y_threads),
+            1);
+        updateTrailingKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(
+            matrix_, panel_, n_, range_.size(), range_.begin, k, first,
+            block_size);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool zeroUpper() const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int threads = 256;
+        const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(
+            (range_.size() + threads - 1) / threads);
+        zeroUpperKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(matrix_, n_, range_.size(),
+                                             range_.begin);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool download(std::vector<double>& host_matrix) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy(host_matrix.data(), matrix_,
+                          host_matrix.size() * sizeof(double),
+                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+private:
+    bool enabled_ = false;
+    std::size_t n_ = 0;
+    std::size_t max_block_ = 0;
+    RowRange range_{0, 0};
+    double* matrix_ = nullptr;
+    double* panel_ = nullptr;
+    double* diagonal_ = nullptr;
+};
+
+#else

+// not have a CUDA compiler.  The CMake target below always builds the real
+// CUDA kernels when CUDA is available.
+class CudaLocalMatrix {

+    bool downloadTile(std::vector<double>&, std::size_t, std::size_t,
+                      std::size_t) const { return false; }
+    bool uploadTile(const std::vector<double>&, std::size_t, std::size_t,
+                    std::size_t) const { return false; }
+    bool uploadDiagonal(const std::vector<double>&, std::size_t) const {
+        return false;
+    }
+    bool solvePanel(std::size_t, std::size_t, std::size_t) const {
+        return false;
+    }
+    bool downloadPanel(std::vector<double>&, std::size_t, std::size_t,
+                       std::size_t, std::size_t) const { return false; }

+    std::printf("  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\n");

+    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
 }

+RowRange rowsForRank(const std::size_t n, const int rank, const int ranks) {

+int ownerOfRow(const std::size_t n, const std::size_t row, const int ranks) {
+    // This inverse of rowsForRank is exact for the quotient/remainder-free
+    // partition used above, including ranks with no rows when ranks > n.
+    int low = 0;
+    int high = ranks - 1;
+    while (low < high) {

+        if (rowsForRank(n, middle, ranks).end <= row) {
+            low = middle + 1;
+        } else {

+        }

+        if (matrix_elements == 0 || panel_elements == 0) {
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        if (cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&matrix_),
+                       matrix_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||
+            cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&panel_),
+                       panel_elements * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess ||
+            cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&diagonal_),
+                       max_block * max_block * sizeof(double)) != cudaSuccess) {
+            release();
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        if (cudaMemcpy(matrix_, host_matrix.data(),
+                       matrix_elements * sizeof(double),
+                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) != cudaSuccess) {
+            release();
+            return false;
+        }
+        enabled_ = true;
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    void release() {
+        if (matrix_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(matrix_);
+        }
+        if (panel_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(panel_);
+        }
+        if (diagonal_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(diagonal_);
+        }
+        matrix_ = nullptr;
+        panel_ = nullptr;
+        diagonal_ = nullptr;
+        enabled_ = false;
+    }
+
+    bool downloadTile(std::vector<double>& tile,
+                      const std::size_t row,
+                      const std::size_t column,
+                      const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy2D(tile.data(), block_size * sizeof(double),
+                            matrix_ + (row - range_.begin) * n_ + column,
+                            n_ * sizeof(double),
+                            block_size * sizeof(double), block_size,
+                            cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool uploadTile(const std::vector<double>& tile,
+                    const std::size_t row,
+                    const std::size_t column,
+                    const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy2D(matrix_ + (row - range_.begin) * n_ + column,
+                            n_ * sizeof(double), tile.data(),
+                            block_size * sizeof(double),
+                            block_size * sizeof(double), block_size,
+                            cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool uploadDiagonal(const std::vector<double>& tile,
+                        const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy(diagonal_, tile.data(),
+                          block_size * block_size * sizeof(double),
+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool solvePanel(const std::size_t k,
+                    const std::size_t first,
+                    const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int threads = 256;
+        const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(
+            (range_.size() + threads - 1) / threads);
+        solvePanelKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(matrix_, diagonal_, n_,
+                                               range_.size(), range_.begin,
+                                               k, first, block_size);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool downloadPanel(std::vector<double>& panel,
+                       const std::size_t row,
+                       const std::size_t rows,
+                       const std::size_t column,
+                       const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (rows == 0) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        return cudaMemcpy2D(panel.data(), block_size * sizeof(double),
+                            matrix_ + (row - range_.begin) * n_ + column,
+                            n_ * sizeof(double),
+                            block_size * sizeof(double), rows,
+                            cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool uploadPanel(const std::vector<double>& panel,
+                     const std::size_t rows,
+                     const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy(panel_, panel.data(),
+                          rows * block_size * sizeof(double),
+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool updateTrailing(const std::size_t k,
+                        const std::size_t first,
+                        const std::size_t block_size) const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0 || first >= n_) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int x_threads = 32;
+        constexpr unsigned int y_threads = 8;
+        const dim3 threads(x_threads, y_threads, 1);
+        const dim3 blocks(
+            static_cast<unsigned int>((n_ - first + x_threads - 1) /
+                                       x_threads),
+            static_cast<unsigned int>((range_.size() + y_threads - 1) /
+                                       y_threads),
+            1);
+        updateTrailingKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(
+            matrix_, panel_, n_, range_.size(), range_.begin, k, first,
+            block_size);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool zeroUpper() const {
+        if (range_.size() == 0) {
+            return true;
+        }
+        constexpr unsigned int threads = 256;
+        const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(
+            (range_.size() + threads - 1) / threads);
+        zeroUpperKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(matrix_, n_, range_.size(),
+                                             range_.begin);
+        return cudaDeviceSynchronize() == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+    bool download(std::vector<double>& host_matrix) const {
+        return cudaMemcpy(host_matrix.data(), matrix_,
+                          host_matrix.size() * sizeof(double),
+                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) == cudaSuccess;
+    }
+
+private:
+    bool enabled_ = false;
+    std::size_t n_ = 0;
+    std::size_t max_block_ = 0;
+    RowRange range_{0, 0};
+    double* matrix_ = nullptr;
+    double* panel_ = nullptr;
+    double* diagonal_ = nullptr;
+};

+bool parseSize(const char* text, std::size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
 }

+RowRange rowsForRank(const std::size_t n, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const std::size_t p = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
+    const std::size_t count = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
+    return {n * p / count, n * (p + 1) / count};

+int ownerOfRow(const std::size_t n, const std::size_t row, const int ranks) {
+    // This inverse of rowsForRank is exact for the quotient/remainder-free
+    // partition used above, including ranks with no rows when ranks > n.
+    int low = 0;
+    int high = ranks - 1;
+    while (low < high) {
+        const int middle = low + (high - low) / 2;
+        if (rowsForRank(n, middle, ranks).end <= row) {
+            low = middle + 1;
+        } else {
+            high = middle;
+        }
+    }
+    return low;
